name: gh_pull_review_create
description: Create a review for a pull request; APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, or COMMENT (POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}/reviews)

repo.description: The repository full name in owner/repo form.

pull_number.description: The number that identifies the pull request.

event.description: The review action you want to perform: APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, or COMMENT.

body.description: Required when using REQUEST_CHANGES or COMMENT. The body text of the pull request review.

user.description: Login of the reviewing user (the authenticated user in the real API). Default: revops-bot.
